title: Recursion
explanation: A recursive method calls itself on a smaller version of the problem. Every one needs a base case - the size at which it stops - or it runs until the stack overflows.
branch() is the classic shape: place a block, then call yourself twice with a shorter length. The tree draws itself without you ever tracking where you are.
floodFill shows the other half of the idea: visit a spot, mark it, then recurse into its neighbours. The marking is what stops it looping forever.
